title: 第11章 坊市之谈
content_zh:
张山、孙康、刘兰三人面带笑容离去之后，李老道面上笑容缓缓褪去，叹息一声坐在桌子前面，连饭菜也没心情去吃。

    “小娃儿，你说，人的命是不是天注定？”

    “刘兰这小女娃的三灵根就这般好，修炼又快，以后筑基都说不定有望，连王管事都不克扣她灵米收获。”

    “我这一把年纪，又是五灵根……方执事当初说的，还真是一点没错，若是按部就班，恐怕一生也难入外门！”

    一开始，李老道还只是抱怨，说到最后，却是一拍桌子霍然站起，声音嘶哑，丑脸狰狞双眼血丝密布，显然已经情绪激动至极。

    韩榆劝道：“道爷，咱们虽然是杂役弟子，但好歹有机会修行，总比那些终生无望、没有灵根的仆从们好的多。”

    万春谷的规矩向来是如此，除非双灵根以上的天才可能直接被长老收徒提前进内门、外门，三灵根、四灵根、五灵根这三种资质不太好的灵根都要从杂役弟子做起。

    三灵根资质的弟子因为在杂役弟子中属于资质好，修炼快的，向来不受欺压，基本最终都会成为外门弟子。

    四灵根、五灵根就不好说了……

    “说得轻巧！”

    李老道握紧拳头，向外走去：“老道我也曾纵马快意，逍遥武林，一生求仙问道，难道是为了这般无能为力？”

    说完之后，也不再和韩榆多说，大踏步地离去。

    背影毅然决然。

    韩榆怔怔看了两眼，低头继续吃饭。

    道爷做的兔子肉，真好吃啊，也不知以后还能不能吃到这种事先放过血的兔子……

    第二日，韩榆与李老道两人来到刘兰的石屋之外。

    除了张山、孙康之外，另有两个男弟子、一个颇为漂亮的女弟子也前来为刘兰庆祝。

    “刘师妹不愧是三灵根的资质，于咱们杂役弟子中绝对是天才！”

    “是啊，过不了多久，就该称呼刘师姐了！”
content_en:
After Zhang Shan, Sun Kang, and Liu Lan left with smiles on their faces, Li Laodao's smile slowly faded and he sat in front of the table with a sigh, not even in the mood to eat.

"Little kid, tell me, is human life destined by God?"

"This little girl Liu Lan's three spiritual roots are so good and she can cultivate quickly. She may be able to build foundations in the future. Even Manager Wang will not deduct her spiritual rice harvest."

"At my age, and with five spiritual roots... what Deacon Fang said at the beginning is absolutely correct. If I follow the steps, I may not be able to enter the outer sect in my lifetime!"

At first, Li Laodao just complained, but at the end, he suddenly stood up with a slap on the table, his voice was hoarse, his ugly face was hideous, his eyes were bloodshot, and he was obviously extremely emotional.

Han Yu advised: "Master Taoist, although we are servant disciples, at least we have the opportunity to practice, which is much better than those servants who have no hope in life and have no spiritual roots."

The rules of Wanchun Valley have always been like this. Unless geniuses with double spiritual roots or above may be directly accepted by the elders as disciples to enter the inner or outer gates in advance, the three spiritual roots with poor qualifications, such as three spiritual roots, four spiritual roots, and five spiritual roots, must all start as handyman disciples.

Disciples with the qualifications of the Three Spiritual Roots are generally not bullied because they have good qualifications and practice quickly among the handyman disciples, and they will basically become outer disciples in the end.

It’s hard to say whether the four spiritual roots or the five spiritual roots are...

"To put it lightly!"

Li Laodao clenched his fists and walked out: "Old Taoist, I once rode my horse to my heart's content, lived freely in the martial arts world, and spent my whole life seeking immortality. Is it because I am so powerless?"

After saying that, he stopped talking to Han Yu and left in large strides.

The figure on the back is resolute.

Han Yu looked at it blankly, then lowered his head and continued eating.

The rabbit meat made by Master Dao is so delicious. I wonder if I will be able to eat rabbits that have been bled beforehand in the future...

On the second day, Han Yu and Li Laodao came outside Liu Lan's stone house.

In addition to Zhang Shan and Sun Kang, two other male disciples and a rather beautiful female disciple also came to celebrate Liu Lan.

"Junior Sister Liu is worthy of her qualifications as a Three Spiritual Roots, and she is definitely a genius among our handyman disciples!"

"Yes, it won't be long before it's time to call me Senior Sister Liu!"
